text: If you keep seeing 222, this is for you.
In numerology, two is the number of connection.
Three of them is the same message, repeated.
A pattern, asking for your attention.
Most people notice it, and keep scrolling.
But a pattern only speaks when you ask it a question.
So ask it now. What is trying to reach me?
And those three hold your answer.
Comment 222, and I'll send you the link to choose your three cards.
